historical_references.reference: Atmaja was the eldest son and successor of the great Hindu emperor Chandragupta Maurya, who ruled from around 321 to 297 BCE. Atmaja was known for his military prowess, and was able to successfully quell a rebellion in the northern part of his empire during his father's later years, allowing Chandragupta to focus on expanding the empire further south. After Chandragupta's death, Atmaja became the emperor and ruled from around 297 to 273 BCE.
historical_references.context: Son and successor of Chandragupta Maurya, known for military prowess and quelling a rebellion

historical_references.reference: Atmaja was the name of a legendary hero in Hindu mythology, who is said to have been the son of the god Indra and the goddess Shachi. He is known for his great strength and bravery, and is often depicted wielding a thunderbolt as a weapon. According to legend, Atmaja was sent by Indra to help the gods in their battle against the demons, and he played a crucial role in their victory.
